gradient_help: baseline_gradient is the active palette; baseline_gradient_default is the original palette kept for reference or restoring colors. Only the active palette changes the heatmap. Each point has workload_ratio (1 = median active-day score in Adaptive, or 85% of reference score in Automatic baseline) and hsl [hue 0-360 degrees, saturation 0-100%, lightness 0-100%]. opacity is 0-100% (0 transparent, 100 opaque). Points must be ordered by ratio. Below starts at 0 and ends at 1; above starts at 1. Colors interpolate smoothly in RGB; the final above color is held for higher workloads. Save to refresh. In Automatic baseline the reference date stays white; empty days stay uncolored.
